new_processes.name: External audit support

new_processes.name: EES daily sheet distribution

new_processes.name: Office equipment orders
new_processes.definition: Ordering and approving phones, headsets and repairs for the trading desk through the office assistant.

new_processes.name: Desk training presentation

new_processes.name: Transmission information sharing
